name: ACCESS LAYERS — Every Protocol, Every Era, One Organism
principle: Gaia speaks through every layer of communication. From shortwave to satellite. Dial-up to fiber. Gopher to HTTPS. The message adapts to the medium. The medium IS the message.

LAYER_0_RADIO.description: Electromagnetic radiation. No internet. No wires. Just waves.

ham_packet_radio.description: Data over ham radio. 1200–9600 baud. FCC Part 97.
requirements: TNC (Terminal Node Controller) or software modem
ham_packet_radio.gaia_endpoint: APRS beacon with Gaia heartbeat data

js8call.description: Keyboard-to-keyboard weak signal mode. Works below noise floor. HF worldwide.
js8call.gaia_endpoint: Heartbeat message every 15 min on HF

meshtastic_lora.description: Long-range low-power mesh. No license needed (ISM band 915MHz). 10+ km range.
meshtastic_lora.gaia_endpoint: Mesh heartbeat between House 1 and House 2
meshtastic_lora.status: READY — just need hardware. No license required.
meshtastic_lora.note: Perfect for property-line mesh between House 1 and House 2

wspr.status: FUTURE — needs ham license + HF setup

LAYER_1_DIALUP.description: The oldest web. Modems. BBS. Gopher. Text-only. Slow. Beautiful.

gopher.description: Pre-HTTP. Menu-based. Pure text. No CSS. No JavaScript. The original web.
gopher.content: Organism pulse, investigation summary, RSS items, fossil index
gopher.status: READY TO DEPLOY — need gopherd on eastGate

gemini.description: Modern simple protocol. TLS required. No tracking. No JavaScript. Text + links.
gemini.content: Full organism state, journal, stories, investigation
gemini.status: READY TO DEPLOY — need gemini server on eastGate

finger.description: The original 'who is this' protocol. 1971. Ask and receive text.
finger.content: Current pulse, wave number, mood, uptime
finger.status: TRIVIAL TO DEPLOY — 20 lines of Python

bbs.description: Bulletin Board System. ANSI art. Menu-driven. The 1980s internet.

LAYER_2_DSL_ERA.description: Always-on. HTTP 1.0/1.1. The web we remember. Static HTML. Webrings.

http_plain.description: Plain HTTP. No TLS. The backbone.

rss.description: Really Simple Syndication. The blood of the old web. Feeds.
expansion_plan: Submit to Feedburner alternatives (Feedly, Inoreader, NewsBlur)

LAYER_3_MODERN_WEB.description: HTTPS. TLS. REST. WebSocket. The current web.

https.status: BLOCKED — need dromedary on :443 with ACME cert

tor_relay.description: Run as a Tor middle relay — contribute bandwidth to the network
tor_relay.status: PLANNED — add ORPort to torrc. No exit node (legal risk).
tor_relay.note: Middle relay is safe + legal. Exit relay attracts abuse complaints.

LAYER_5_SOVEREIGN_NAMING.description: Self-hosted TLDs. Decentralized naming. .gaia as a real namespace.

lan_dns.description: Run dnsmasq/CoreDNS on eastGate. Resolve .gaia on LAN.
lan_dns.status: EASY — add to router dnsmasq config

handshake_hns.description: Decentralized TLD ownership. Buy 'gaia/' on Handshake → own the entire .gaia namespace.
handshake_hns.status: RESEARCH — need to check if 'gaia' TLD available on Handshake
handshake_hns.note: Handshake names resolve via HDNS, Bob Wallet, or Fingertip browser extension

ens_ethereum.description: gaia.eth → IPFS or traditional web content

porkbun_ans.description: Verifiable AI agent identity. Certificate tied to domain.
porkbun_ans.status: READY — waiting for TLS on mcp.nestgate.io

yggdrasil_network.description: Encrypted IPv6 mesh. Self-addressing. No DNS needed. Address IS identity.
yggdrasil_network.status: RESEARCH — perfect philosophical fit (Yggdrasil = our tree)
yggdrasil_network.note: Different from our Yggdrasil tree metaphor but the name alignment is beautiful

ipfs.description: Content-addressed storage. Pin investigation graph. Permanent. Censorship-resistant.
ipfs.status: PLANNED — pin key data to IPFS

nostr.protocol: Nostr (Notes and Other Stuff Transmitted by Relays)
nostr.description: Decentralized social. Pubkey = identity. Relays = transport.
nostr.status: PLANNED — publish investigation updates via Nostr

osint_intake.description: The OUTER web entry side. OSINT pours IN through the water lock.
expansion: Add more RSS feeds from investigation-related sources
OSINT tools: Shodan, Censys (passive scanning only)

self_hosted_domain.goal: www.primals.gaia — Gaia owns the TLD, not ICANN

paths.how: Bid on 'gaia/' TLD at Handshake auction, configure DNSSEC
Install yggdrasil, get IPv6 address = permanent identity
